hints.content: Each year, the number of members is multiplied by $1.2$.

If we start with the initial number of members, $10$ members, and keep multiplying by $1.2$, this function gives us the number of members in the cooking club $t$ years after it started.

$m(t)=10(1.2)^t$

question.content:
